en.quote: And the children of Israel cried unto the LORD, saying, We have sinned against thee, both because we have forsaken our God, and also served Baalim.
en.riddle: We have forsaken our God, and have served the Baalim.
en.speaker: children of Israel

he.quote: וַֽיִּזְעֲקוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל-יְהוָה לֵאמֹר חָטָאנוּ לָךְ וְכִי עָזַבְנוּ אֶת-אֱלֹהֵינוּ, וַנַּעֲבֹד אֶת-הַבְּעָלִים.
he.speaker: בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל
